original.target_description: Experiment 1: foresight versus one-alternative hindsight, estimated recurrence probability. Broad description and p. 3 locator leave four scenarios, two initial outcomes per scenario, and all/some/none recurrence responses unresolved; no unique test selected.

n.sample_role: Participants; 184 is the Experiment 1 total, not an established analytic sample for any particular contrast.
n.exclusions: No target-test exclusions or exact group counts established. Group sizes are given only as ranges; no analytic N sum is justified.

notes: Assigned original fields only; replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. PDF pp. 3–4 rendered and visually inspected. No target was selected by row order or numeric matching. Table 1 reports condition mean probabilities, not a standardized effect or an omnibus comparison coefficient. Candidate same-outcome recurrence contrasts, foresight/hindsight means and SAME Experiment 1 test bounds: virgin rat shows maternal behavior/all show: .30/.44, p < .05; virgin rat fails to show/none show: .57/.67, no star and no numeric p printed; hurricane intensity increases/all increase: .29/.56, p < .001; hurricane intensity decreases/all weaken: .34/.47, p < .05; gosling approaches goose/all approach goose: .40/.73, p < .001; gosling approaches duck/all approach duck: .40/.42, no star and no numeric p printed; Y-test initial Area A/Area A: .29/.58, p < .001; Y-test initial Area B/Area B: .16/.36, p < .001. Additional some/none response contrasts also appear in Table 1. These are candidates, not assigned effect estimates. Results on p. 546 additionally describe aggregate always-replicated probabilities .38 foresight and .55 hindsight for the three multiple-replication scenarios, and never-replicated probabilities .19 and .10, without an aggregate coefficient/test or numeric p. No conversions or N derivations performed. The total 184 and ranges 24–37 (Experiment 1) and 24–41 (combined Table 1) do not establish contrast-specific analytic N. Canonical OCR ***# < .001. was visually verified as *** p < .001.; quoted OCR remains literal.
